policy: Fuel Management Policy & Process, V5.1, Y2025
description: In case any fueling card got any problem like it is snatched/damaged/swipe machine at fuel station is not operational: Solution: In such cases temporary loan can be obtained from fueling station which is required be paid off with in the same month in which loan is obtained. In case of any blockage of fuel cards due to payments issues or budget issues: Solution: Fuel cards might get blocked due to the payment issues or any other technical error. In this case, confirmation to be taken from NOMC Fuel analyst and with the approval of Manager FOPs & RCTO, fuel should be taken on loan. Apart from above two scenarios, fuel should not be taken on loan from any fueling station. It should be ensured that all the loan/credit-based fuel (due to above mentioned two scenarios) should be cleared off in the same month. If it is not paid off in the same month due to machine error or internet connectivity error on last date of the month, then with the approval of Manager FOPs & RCTO, it should be paid off at very earliest to clear the credit of fueling station. The fuel rate difference should be covered in the quantity of liters. All the cases of taking fuel on loan must be approved by FOP's Manager and RCTO.
